Welcome to Doc Flow - Cebu Chiropractor!

Doc Flow is a French-licensed Doctor of Chiropractic (D.C.) with 5 years of experience helping patients move and feel their best. Originally from Paris, France, Doc Flow now calls Cebu City home and is proud to offer personalized chiropractic care to Filipinos 🇵🇭🇫🇷

✅ 5 years of international and local experience
✅ French-licensed chiropractor
✅ Now accepting appointments in Cebu City

Move better. Feel better. Live better — with Doc Flow.

📩 Message us to book your session today!
